"Entered according to Act of Congress in the year 1858 by S. L. Jones in the Clerk's Office for the Eastern Dist. of Pa." Includes business directories, distance table, views of residential, public, and commercial buildings. Insets: Colon -- Sturgis -- Leonidas -- Burr Oak -- Parkville -- Three Rivers -- Flowerfield Village -- Centreville -- Mendon -- Constantine -- Montville -- White Pigeon -- Lockport. LC copy imperfect: Mounted on cloth backing, original sheets sectioned into 6 panels to enable folding.
